create_object_detection_params: create an ObjectDetectionParams instance with custom learning rate, epochs, and batch size for training
configure_object_detection_model: configure ObjectDetectionParams to use a specific Hugging Face model and optimizer for object detection
set_object_detection_data_columns: set the image_column and objects_column fields in ObjectDetectionParams to match your dataset schema
enable_early_stopping: configure ObjectDetectionParams with early_stopping_patience and early_stopping_threshold to halt training on no improvement
push_object_detection_to_hub: set push_to_hub and token in ObjectDetectionParams to upload the trained model to Hugging Face Hub
